title: A Semismooth Newton-Based Proximal Augmented Lagrangian Method for Joint Estimation of Multiple Gaussian Graphical Models with Clustered Structure
summary: In this paper, we consider a class of convex composite optimization problems arising from the joint estimation of clustered multiple Gaussian graphical models. The resulting model combines a log-determinant loss term with a nonsmooth sparse clustered regularizer, which encourages both similar sparsity patterns and consistent edge values across different graphs.
